ledger.x: c. 1150: the Lupaca kingdom is established near Lake Titicaca. Infobox 'established c. 1150'; the Lupaca and other Aymara peoples 'formed powerful kingdoms after the collapse of the Tiwanaku Empire in the 11th century'.

c. 1463: Pachacuti brings the Lupaca into the Inca Empire. 'The Lupaca were incorporated into the growing Inca Empire by the emperor Pachacuti'; infobox conquest c. 1463 (Pachacuti reigned 1438-1471). The Inca Empire dossier (inca-empire) records the matching gain.

c. 1463: the independent Lupaca kingdom ends under the Inca. The infobox keeps the polity to c. 1600 (capital Chucuito from 1463), as a province; the Inca crushed a Lupaca-Colla revolt c. 1473 under Topa Inca Yupanqui.
